title: Amount of a hardship waiver on a Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
The amount of a hardship waiver on a Urology and Continence Supply Program is worked from the approved hardship application on file and the posting it names.

## Records read

The application is the program's approved hardship application with the latest received date. The named posting is the posting it names, with its amount and posting date. When the program carries no approved hardship application, no waiver is owed.

## Waiver

1. The waived amount is the named posting's amount.
2. The waiver share is one half (0.5).
3. The waiver is the waived amount times the waiver share, rounded to the nearest cent on the final figure only.

Each adjustment to the waiver changes it as that adjustment states. Amounts are added to or taken from the waived amount, which never falls below zero. The waiver share is replaced before anything is added to it, and the share never exceeds the whole of the waived amount.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

The approved application names a posting of 63.46 USD. The waived amount is 63.46 USD, and the waiver is 63.46 times 0.5, which is 31.73 USD.
